name: WowAddons – Product Addons for WooCommerce
author: WPXPO

sections.description:
WowAddons is a new yet promising WooCommerce Product Addons plugin. It helps to add extra options to the product pages. So the shoppers can create their personalized versions of the products.

It has a quick and smart addons builder that allows you to add image/color swatches, file uploads, radio buttons, and any other essential options. Moreover, you can also charge for extra product options. So WowAddons can also be used for upselling & cross-selling and boost the average order value.

The Ultimate WooCommerce Product Addons/Options

WowAddons is the most advanced plugin for adding extra product options. With its dynamic options and easy-to-understand UI, anyone can create product personalization experiences.
WowAddons comes with various components for adding custom fields and extra product options. Following the available core components:

✅ Radio Button
✅ Checkbox
✅ Switch
✅ Dropdown
✅ Upload
✅ Button
✅ Image Swatches
✅ Color Swatches
✅ Color Picker
✅ Date
✅ Time
✅ Range Slider
✅ URL/Link
✅ Mail
✅ Number
✅ Telephone
✅ Text Area
✅ Heading
✅ Section
✅ Short Code
✅ Separator
✅ Spacer

Next Gen Builder

WowRevenue has the most simplified and efficient builder, allowing you to add extra product options effortlessly. Drag and drop your desired components and customize them as per your requirements.

Color/Image Swatches

Convert dull variations into attractive swatch buttons for both colors and images. You can also set different pricing for different variations.

Upload Files/Images

You can let your customers upload their desired images or files using this element. It can be highly impactful for the printing business.

Text Area

The text area can be used in multiple ways. Customers can write additional notes or any custom text that can be added or written on the product they want to purchase.

Conditional Fileds

Make specific or multiple fields dependent on other fields. So, you can show or hide your desired field by selecting a specific option. It helps you to create engaging product personalization flexibility for shoppers.

Dynamic Price Adjustments

You can add regular and sales price-adding options for almost all fields available with the WowAddons. So you can effortlessly charge for additional product options. It will help you increase the value of your order and boost revenue.

Product Asiging Options

With the product assigning option, you can instantly add product options to specific products. However, you can also assign extra options to the products of specific categories or all products.

Boost Order Value with WowAddons

WowAddons is not just for creating product personalization experiences with additional fields. You can also use it to increase the average order value of your WooCommerce store. How?
Explore the following upselling and cross-selling examples that can be achieved with WowAddons.

** Upselling: ** You can encourage shoppers to get a high-end product variation with beautiful color or image swatches. And, you can charge extra to increase the order value.

** Cross-selling: ** Suppose you sell birthday cakes online. You can effortlessly cross-sell sparking candles at an extra charge and get better order value every Time.

Thank you for considering WowAddons. We have more plugins that can be beneficial for your business. So please have a look at our other plugins.

💝 WowStore: An all-in-one WooCommerce solution to create professional and conversion-focused eCommerce stores.

  • Customizable Product Options: Add extra fields like text boxes, dropdowns, checkboxes, and file uploads to your products.
  • Flexible Pricing: Set additional costs for add-ons to reflect the value of customization.
  • Easy-to-Use Interface: Intuitive backend interface for creating and managing add-ons without any coding knowledge.
  • Conditional Logic: Show or hide add-ons based on customer selections for a dynamic shopping experience.
  • Compatibility: Seamlessly integrates with all WooCommerce themes and most third-party plugins.
  • File Uploads: Allow customers to upload files for personalized products like logos, designs, or documents.
  • Global and Product-Specific Add-ons: Apply add-ons globally to all products or selectively to specific items.

Benefits:

  • Boost Sales: Upsell and cross-sell by offering personalized options.
  • Enhance Customer Experience: Provide a tailored shopping experience that meets individual needs.
  • Increase Customer Satisfaction: Let customers create exactly what they want, reducing returns and increasing satisfaction.
  • Save Time: Easily manage add-ons and product customization from your WooCommerce dashboard.

Whether you’re selling personalized gifts, customizable products, or services with additional options, Product Addons empowers you to take your store to the next level. Perfect for businesses of all sizes, this plugin helps you stand out in a competitive market by offering unique and flexible product customization options.

sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0.0 or greater
  • PHP version 7.3 or greater
  • MySQL version 5.6 or greater

Automatic installation

Automatic installation is the easiest option as WordPress handles the file transfers itself and you don’t even need to leave your web browser.

  1. Go to your WordPress Plugin installation menu (Dashboard > Plugins > Add New)
  2. In the search field type “Product Addons” and press enter.
  3. “Install Now” and then click “Active”

Manual installation

For Manual installation, you download our product from WordPress directory uploading it to your web-server via your FTP or CPanel application.

  1. Download the plugin and unzip it
  2. Using an FTP program or CPanel upload the unzipped plugin folder to your WordPress installation’s wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu (Dashboard > Plugins > Installed Plugins) within the WordPress admin.

Upgrading

Automatic update working great for this plugin. If you customize the plugin make sure to store a backup before update.

Sometimes because of the permalink issue during the plugin update, just go to WordPress > Settings > Permalinks and hit the ‘Save’ button.
sections.faq:
Is WowAddons suitable for all types of WooCommerce stores?

Yes, WowAddons is suitable for any WooCommerce store, no matter what types of products you sell.

Do I need coding knowledge to use WowAddons?

No, you don’t need to have any kind of coding knowledge to use WowAddons.

Does WowAddons slow down my website?

No, WowAddons will not make your site slow, as we have developed it with efficient and modern coding language.

Can customers upload images or files using WowAddons?

Yes, you can allow your customers to upload images or files by using WowAddons.

Can I assign extra options to specific products or categories?

Yes, you can assign extra options to specific products or products from specific categories.
